nodes.summary: AND-gate production in the logic approximation: rate `β` when `K_x < x` and `K_y < y`, else `0`.
nodes.title: AND-gate production rate in the logic approximation

nodes.summary: For a nonnegative threshold `K_xz`, whatever `Y` does, the FFL and simple regulation decay identically after an OFF step: `Z(t) = z₀ e^{-α_z t}`.
nodes.title: No OFF delay

nodes.summary: The FFL target after `Sx` is removed at `t = 0` (`X* = 0`), starting from `Z(0) = z₀`, for an arbitrary trajectory `Y` of the intermediate factor.
nodes.title: Feed-forward loop target after an OFF step

nodes.summary: The FFL target stays at `0` until `T_on`.
nodes.title: ON delay

nodes.summary: After `T_on` the FFL target relaxes from `0` towards `β_z/α_z`: `Z(t) = (β_z/α_z)(1 - e^{-α_z (t - T_on)})` (for `α_z > 0`, `K_xz < 1`).
nodes.title: Delayed rise

nodes.summary: The FFL target after an ON step of `Sx` at `t = 0` from `Y(0) = Z(0) = 0`, with `X* = 1` and `K_xz < 1`.
nodes.title: Feed-forward loop target after an ON step

nodes.summary: The relaxation solves `z' = P - α z` at every time where the (locally integrable) production rate `P` is continuous.
nodes.title: Relaxation solution satisfies its differential equation

nodes.summary: `yOn` solves `Y' = β_y - α_y Y` with `Y(0) = 0` (for `α_y ≠ 0`; at `α_y = 0` Lean's `β_y / 0 = 0` makes `yOn` identically `0`, which is not a solution).
nodes.title: Intermediate factor solves its production–decay equation

nodes.summary: The ON-step delay `T_on = (1/α_y) log(1 / (1 - K_yz / Y_st))`, `Y_st = β_y/α_y`: the time at which `Y` crosses the activation threshold `K_yz` of `Z`. Meaningful for `0 < K_yz < Y_st`.
nodes.title: ON-step delay of the feed-forward loop

nodes.summary: The variation-of-constants solution of `z' = P(t) - α z`, `z(0) = z₀`: `z(t) = z₀ e^{-α t} + ∫₀ᵗ e^{-α (t - s)} P(s) ds`. Used for `t ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Variation-of-constants solution of a linear relaxation equation

nodes.summary: Single-input production in the logic approximation: rate `β` when `K_x < x`, else `0`.
nodes.title: Single-input production rate in the logic approximation

nodes.summary: The simple-regulation target after `Sx` is removed at `t = 0`, from `Z(0) = z₀`.
nodes.title: Simple-regulation target after an OFF step

nodes.summary: Simple regulation responds without delay: `Z(t) = (β_z/α_z)(1 - e^{-α_z t}) > 0` for all `t > 0`.
nodes.title: Simple regulation responds without delay

nodes.summary: The simple-regulation target after an ON step of `Sx` at `t = 0` from `Z(0) = 0`.
nodes.title: Simple-regulation target after an ON step

nodes.summary: `Y` exceeds `K_yz` exactly after the ON delay: `K_yz < Y(t) ↔ T_on < t`.
nodes.title: Intermediate factor exceeds the threshold exactly after the ON delay

nodes.summary: `Y` after an ON step of `Sx` from `Y(0) = 0`: `Y(t) = (β_y/α_y)(1 - e^{-α_y t})`.
nodes.title: Intermediate factor after an ON step

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
